findings: The pinned Mirheo::run invokes setup; Simulation::run executes initial splitters on every invocation, including run(0).
correct_every=0 disables scheduled correction tasks but does not prevent repeated initial splitting of outer into inner.
Simulation::run also clears object local/halo forces on entry. Bouncer reaction forces are accumulated after integration for the next step; a new run boundary can discard that pending contribution.
A2 inner population increases from 642 to 643 while total population remains 110592; its completion field classifier_corrections=0 is not a complete accounting of classification operations.
Existing probe-no-mismatch results do not establish impermeability in the presence of these implicit classification calls.
Native ParticleSenderPlugin::beforeForces observes positions/velocities and ids within the same run, avoiding these observation boundaries.
